decided: In the brief, each judgement in the ledger names what it relies on (which requirement, ruling, goal, earlier answer or exploration decision) without quoting it, and a change's requirements are labelled as not yet synced whenever the brief is made before the archive records the sync.
alternatives: quote the text of everything each judgement relies on, as the reading step's brief does
label the copy the archive saves as what that archive syncs
why: The user signing off needs to know what each judgement rests on, and the reading step has already checked the wording against the quoted text; one label is true however the brief was made, while the command that saves it cannot tell whether the archive or a person ran it.
